summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the DPA/legal, promo-code and owner-panel iteration. Backend: 33 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_dpa_promo_iter6.py covering both owner logins (email + username), public DPA doc (v1.1, 14 sections, Fernet ciphertext verified unreadable directly in Mongo), DPA status/accept + DB persistence (dpa_acceptances row with signature_sha256 + encrypted envelope, user row updated), signed PDF (%PDF-, content-disposition Learnify-DPA-<school>-YYYYMMDD, signed_pdf_download audit row), owner acceptances/CSV/reminders (+403 for non-owners), promo CRUD (builtin HWA26 prepended, duplicate/reserved/format/days validation, PATCH disable + 404), school signup with HWA26 and a fresh single-use code (2nd use correctly 400), and /api/owner/stats + /api/owner/schools regression for BOTH owners. Result: 32 passed, 1 skipped (TESTCODE1 already existed from prior run), 0 failed. Frontend: Khalida login -> /dashboard blocked by [data-testid=dpa-gate], accept dismissed it and it did NOT reappear on reload; /owner tabs overview/promo/dpa all render, promo create + toggle work (row promo-row-UITEST1343 with 0/3 uses, DISABLED after toggle), builtin HWA26 row shown without a toggle button, DPA panel shows renewal reminders (2 never-signed) + 7 acceptance rows, Export CSV downloaded learnify-dpa-acceptances-20260820.csv; /dpa public renders 14 sections with no download card when signed out, and signed-in the card downloads Learnify-DPA-UI_Test_School-20260820.pdf. No console errors, no blocked clicks.

minor.issue: CSV emits duplicate data: columns 'name_or_school' and 'school_name' are both populated from r.get('school_name'); the header suggests one should be the user's name (r.get('name')/email owner name).
Request body is an untyped `payload: dict = None` instead of a Pydantic model, so school_name length/type is unvalidated (any JSON accepted). Low risk but inconsistent with the rest of the API.

integration_issues.issue: DpaGate fails OPEN: any network/500 error on GET /legal/dpa/status sets status={accepted:true}, so a transient backend failure lets an un-accepted user through the compliance gate. Consider fail-closed with a retry/error state.

action_items: Optional: fix duplicate school_name column in the owner DPA CSV export (name_or_school should carry the signer's name).
Optional: make DpaGate fail-closed (or show a retry) when /legal/dpa/status errors, instead of assuming accepted.

Optional cleanup: test artefacts left in DB - promo codes TESTCODE1 (disabled), NEWCODE*, UITEST1343 (disabled); test schools test<hex>.sch.uk whose school_admins now appear in DPA 'never signed' reminders.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 2653 lines - split into routers (auth, legal_dpa, promo, owner, schools) for maintainability.
Owner-only guard `if not is_owner(current): raise 403` is duplicated across ~8 endpoints - extract a FastAPI dependency (Depends(require_owner)).
Passwords for owner/co-owner are re-hashed and overwritten on every startup, so any password change made through the app for these accounts is silently reverted.
